lines.text: Many learners say: Everyone are happy today.

native.tip: “Semua orang” terasa banyak, tapi bahasa Inggris memakai is setelah everyone.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Everyone are happy today.” 😅 Setelah everyone, pakai is: “Everyone is happy today.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “is”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “Everyone is happy today.” Lalu ganti happy dengan tired. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: “Semua orang” feels like many, but English uses is after everyone.
en.caption: Ever say this? “Everyone are happy today.” 😅 After everyone, use is: “Everyone is happy today.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
